# Settings — Global
{: .no_toc }

Preferences that apply to every app.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `SET-01` |
| **Route** | `/settings` · deep link `substratal://settings` |
| **Where** | Personal › Settings |
| **Who can use it** | Self |
| **Kind** | settings |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (MVP) |
| **On Linux** | `AdwPreferencesPage` |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Language | select | Settings.locale | BCP 47; default = OS language; changing re-localizes the UI live | AdwComboRow |
| Time zone | searchable select | Settings.timezone | IANA; default = OS zone; "Use device time zone" option | AdwComboRow enable-search |
| Appearance | segmented | Settings.theme light/dark/system | Light · Dark · Match system (default). Applies instantly; Match system follows OS changes live. See THEMES.md | linked GtkToggleButtons |
| Light theme | swatch picker | `app_hub` setting `appearance.light_theme` | 5 themes: Teal Ledger, Indigo Root, **Moss Paper (default)**, Coral Clay, Spore Pink. Each swatch previews background, sidebar, accent and text; selected swatch shows a check and accent ring; accessible name "{name} light theme, selected" | GtkFlowBox of swatch GtkCheckButtons (grouped) in an AdwPreferencesGroup |
| Dark theme | swatch picker | `app_hub` setting `appearance.dark_theme` | 5 themes: Night Soil, Deep Teal, Graphite Spore, **Forest Floor (default)**, Ember Clay. Same behaviour as Light theme | GtkFlowBox of swatch GtkCheckButtons (grouped) in an AdwPreferencesGroup |
| Push notifications | toggle | Settings.notifications.push (missing = on) | global master switch for push from every app; inbox still fills (NTF-01). Shows OS permission state beneath: "Allowed in system settings" / "Blocked — Open system settings" | AdwSwitchRow |
| Email notifications | toggle | Settings.notifications.email |  | AdwSwitchRow |
| SMS notifications | toggle | Settings.notifications.sms | disabled until Profile.contact_phone set | AdwSwitchRow |
| Share usage analytics | toggle | client preference | default per platform policy; see CLIENT-ARCHITECTURE §10 | AdwSwitchRow |
| Scope list | list | Global + each app with active access | → SET-02 (desktop: middle column) | GtkListBox .boxed-list |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Change any row | `PATCH /users/me/settings (If-Match)` | Optimistic; revert + toast on error. |
| Choose a light or dark theme | `PATCH /users/me/apps/app_hub/settings (If-Match)` with `appearance.light_theme` / `appearance.dark_theme` | Apply instantly, cache locally, then sync; 409 → refetch and re-apply; 422 → revert + toast "Couldn't save your theme. Try again." |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: skeleton after 300 ms; Error: inline with Retry; codes per COPY-AND-STATES

## For developers

Loads: `GET /users/me/settings` · `GET /users/me/apps/app_hub/settings` (theme choices)

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
